# Diani Bikes

> Diani Bikes is a local bike tour, rental, and excursion operator on the Kenyan coast, offering guided bike tours, mountain and electric bike rentals, tuk tuk experiences, and marine excursions across Diani, Watamu, and Kilifi.

Diani Bikes ("A Cultural Adventure") was founded by Masha Kirao to inspire and empower adventurers of all ages to discover the wonders of the Kenyan coast in a fun, eco-friendly, and authentic way - on two wheels, by tuk tuk, by boat, or by camel. Tours are led by local, English-speaking guides. Open Monday–Saturday, 8am–6pm (closed Sundays). Locations: Diani Bazaar, Diani, and Jiweleupe, Watamu. Contact: +254 713 959668, info@dianibike-tours.com.

## Bike Tours
- [Mijikenda Village & Culture Bike Tour](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/mijikenda-village-culture-bike-tour): Am immersive journey into the heart of coastal Kenya! This guided tour takes you through a bustling village market, a local community school, and directly into an authentic Mijikenda homestead.
- [Village Guided Bike Tour](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/village-guided-bike-tour): Ride through the heart of local village life on this guided bike tour through Diani and Watamu.

## Tuk Tuk Experience
- [Bush Tour](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/bush-tour): Get off the beaten track on a rugged ride through the coastal bush between Diani
- [Giraffe Feeding Adventure](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/giraffe-feeding-adventure): Join us for an unforgettable Giraffe Feeding Adventure and immerse yourself in the magic of wildlife encounters in Diani!
- [Kaya Kinondo Sacred Forest](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/kaya-kinondo-sacred-forest): Journey into the spiritual heart of Diani at Kaya Kinondo, one of the oldest sacred forests of the Mijikenda people.
- [Malindi & Gede Ruins Tour](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/malindi-gede-ruins-tour): On this half-day excursion, we’ll dive right into the living culture, history, and beauty of the Kenyan coast.
- [Mambrui Sand Dunes & Marafa Hells Kitchen](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/mambrui-sand-dunes-marafa-hells-kitchen): This half-day journey pairs the ocean-swept golden slopes of the MAMBRUI SAND DUNES with the striking sandstone gullies of Hell’s Kitchen in Marafa.
- [Mijikenda Village & Cultural TukTuk Tour](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/mijikenda-village-cultural-tuktuk-tour): Hop into an open-air TukTuk for an authentic journey into the heart of coastal Kenya!
- [Robinson Island and Marafa Hell Kitchen Tour](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/robinson-island-and-marafa-hell-kitchen-tour): Combining Robinson Island and Marafa into a single trip pairs a secluded seafood beach experience with a dramatic sunset hike.

## Marine Excursions
- [Camel Adventure](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/camel-adventure): Trade two wheels for four legs with a relaxed camel ride along the white sand of Diani beach.
- [Full Day Wasini Island & Dolphin Tour](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/full-day-private-dolphin-tour): Set out on a private full-day dolphin tour around Wasini Island aboard your own yacht.
- [Glass bottom boat](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/beach-tour): Half day fun excursion with Snorkeling at Robinson Island
- [Mangrove Tour (Sundowner)](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/mangrove-sundowner): Enjoy a serene boat trip at the Kongo River Estuary, where you can spot wildlife like mangroves, birds .
- [Nature Trail and Dhow Cruise](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/nature-trail-and-dhow-cruise): Combine ancient forest wilderness with a tranquil mangrove cruise on this ultimate tour in Watamu.

## Forest Excursions
- [Elephant Sporting](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/elephant-sporting): Hop into an open-air Tuk-Tuk for an exciting drive along the rugged natural trails of Arabuko Sokoke Forest.
- [Gede Ruins Tour](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/gede-ruins-tour): Discover the ancient Swahili ruins of Gede, hidden within the forest near Watamu and among the coast's best-preserved historic sites.
- [Monkey Trails And Conservation Centre](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/monkey-trails-and-conservation-centre): Explore the Monkey Trails and Conservation Centre in Diani for a quick but amazing adventure! Meet the old-world monkeys called Pili Colobus and discover their home in the trees.
- [Nature Trail Guided Tour](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/nature-trail-guided-tour): Step into East Africa's largest remaining coastal dry forest for an unforgettable guided nature walk in Arabuko Sokoke Forest! Led by our expert local guides
- [Ruins of Mnarani](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/ruins-of-mnarani): Talk a walk in Nature down memery lane as you learn about the rich hisorty Swahili people and culture and travde of the people who lived in Gede.
- [Snake Show And School](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/tours/snake-show-and-school): An educational, family-friendly stop to see the coast's native snake species up close in a safe, controlled setting.

## Rentals
- [Bike Rentals](https://dianibikes.vercel.app/rentals.html): Mountain, electric, manual, and kids' bikes - helmet and lock included with every rental.
